Associate Nurse Unit Manager - Day of Surgery Admissions   $57.78 - $59.72 per hour plus 12% super   Full Time - Ongoing   Cabrini Malvern   We're building for the better!  By 2036, more than 150,000 patients will look to us for healthcare every year.    At  Cabrini Health  we champion community, compassion and career fulfilment. Our teams are united by the shared purpose of making a meaningful contribution to exceptional, patient-centred care in well- resourced, world class facilities that inspire you to perform at your best and continuously grow professionally.    Why join Cabrini Health's Leadership Team in Perioperative Services?  At Cabrini, we are committed to excellence in surgical care. Our state-of-the-art Perioperative Services have expanded, offering exciting opportunities for experienced and aspiring theatre nurses to grow and thrive in a supportive and cutting-edge environment. 
 
 24 modern operating theatres + three endoscopy suites + three Cardiac Catheter Labs 
 Advanced technology including the da Vinci Robot, Brainlab & Stealth navigation 
 A diverse case mix - Orthopaedics, Urology, Gynaecology, Obstetrics, ENT, Plastics, General, Paediatrics, Cardiac, Neurosurgery & more 
 Strong focus on education & career development - access to specialty training & leadership pathways 
 
 We are offering an exceptional opportunity for an experienced nursing leader to help shape the future of Cabrini's Day of Surgery Admissions Service. This role provides the chance to make a meaningful impact by leading a dedicated team, driving innovation, and enhancing the patient experience across the surgical journey.  Ideal for a motivated clinician ready to take the next step in their leadership career, this position draws on your perioperative or surgical nursing expertise to ensure the delivery of safe, efficient, and patient-centred care from admission through to surgery.   How you will make an impact:  
 
 Lead the day-to-day operations of a busy preoperative admissions department, ensuring the delivery of safe, high-quality care and an exceptional patient experience. 
 Drive continuous improvement, innovation, and best-practice initiatives within a well-established and highly regarded service. 
 Inspire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team that embraces collaboration, accountability, and a positive "can-do" culture. 
 Partner with surgeons, anaesthetists, perioperative teams, and hospital leaders to optimise patient flow and support excellent surgical outcomes. 
 
  What we're looking for:  
 
 Current AHPRA registration (Registered Nurse) 
 Victorian Working with Children Check 
 Demonstrated leadership experience in perioperative services, surgical admissions, pre-admission, or an acute care settings. 
 Strong understanding of perioperative processes, patient flow, and preparation of the pre-operative patient 
 A vision and passion for team development and professional growth 
 A commitment to clinical excellence and patient-centred care 
 Flexibility and a positive attitude 
 Attention to detail 
 Excellent customer service focus and communication skills 
 Enthusiasm for participation and leading in a team environment 
 
  What we offer:  
 
 A private, non-profit hospital which offers $15,900 salary packaging tax free plus $2,650 meal & entertainment card benefits 
 Our culture is inclusive; we work as a team and are constantly focusing on professional and career development 
 $4 per day car parking available at each of our hospital sites 
 We offer flexible working arrangements inclusive of a 4 -day work week and flexible shift lengths 
 Additional Employee Leave Benefits 
 Close to public transport with Myki discount on offer 
 Working with the latest modern technology and established surgeons 
 Exciting expansion at Cabrini Hospital Malvern of theatre services, consulting spaces, and a redeveloped emergency department in 2026 
 
  Associate Nurse Unit Manager Position Description   here     Enquiries to:  Jeramie Carson - Nurse Manager - Access and Flow on (03) 9508 8514    Apply early!  This role may close sooner than the listed closing date if we find the right candidate - so don't wait to get your application in.    To find out more please visit our Careers website:   https://www.cabrini.com.au/work-with-us/perioperative-services/    

 Does this sound like your new role? Bring your skills and enthusiasm to Cabrini Health and help optimise the patient experience and health outcomes for our community. 
 Cabrini Health acknowledges the importance of creating a work environment that is welcoming, safe, equitable and inclusive for people of all backgrounds and abilities. Inclusion is core to our mission. 
 As part of our commitment to Reconciliation and Closing the Gap in employment related outcomes, we encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples. 
  Working for Cabrini  
 Cabrini Health is a Catholic, private, for-purpose health service located in Melbourne's southeast. Inspired by the mission and ethic of care of the Cabrini Sisters, providing quality, compassionate care to our community for more than 75 years. 
 There is something special about Cabrini Health. Our highly skilled staff and specialists incorporate clinical research, innovative models of care and state-of-the-art technology to deliver the best possible care and outcomes for our patients. We demonstrate our mission to serve our community through outreach programs that support asylum seekers, provide healthcare in rural communities and in underdeveloped countries. 
 Our size, reputation and growth strategy ensure genuine opportunities for our people to learn, grow and realise potential. 
  Our values: Compassion - Integrity - Courage - Respect  
  MANDATORY FOR ALL NEW STAFF TO CABRINI  
 Employment with Cabrini Health will be based on satisfactory background checks such as professional references, National Police Check, vaccinations for annual Influenza and COVID-19 (recommended), plus a Working with Children Check (WWCC) may also be requested.  Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
Echo Marine Group is an Australian owned and operated company with over 10 years' experience in the Marine Industry. We specialise in the manufacture of Luxury Superyachts and Commercial Workboats. We also carry out maintenance on a full range of vessels in the Superyacht, Workboat and Defence areas.
Due to the increased workload and new upcoming projects, we are looking for enthusiastic and proactive Fitters to join our Engineering Team. So if you are looking for full time employment and have the necessary skills of a Pipe Fitter or Marine Fitter this may be the role for you!
About the Position:
What work will you be doing?
•	Installation of machinery and piping systems into vessels under construction or during maintenance/refit works.
•	Fabrication of piping systems to be installed into vessels, being worked on at Echo Marine.
•	Installation of marine power plants, shafting and auxiliary systems (Note no engine mechanical works is carried out by Echo Marine).
Who are we looking for?
To be successful for this position, you must ideally possess some of the following skills:
•	Marine Fitting experience preferred however, aligned trades including hydraulic piping installation, sprinkler installers or Plumbers will also be considered
•	Be able to read and understand drawings to construct systems and equipment into vessels under construction or maintenance
•	Pipe fabrication including working with stainless and copper nickel.
•	TIG Welding skills, with thin wall tube (1.5mm) experience would be an advantage.
•	Manual tube bending and flaring of tube up to 32mm in diameter.
What we can offer you!!
In return for your skills and experience, Echo Marine Group can offer:
•	Weekly pay
•	4-day 38hr week (Monday – Thursday 5.55am to 3.55pm)
•	Overtime rates apply outside these times and after 38hrs completed)
•	Waterfront location
